title: FY2017 Section 5311 Rural Area Formula Program grant application
source_representation: scan-only PDF; indexed/visually reviewed, full OCR pending staged extraction
purpose: Rural Area Formula Program (5311), State Fiscal Year 2017.
compliance_evidence: The application checklist is divided into Planning & Programming and Compliance.

Planning/programming materials include project/service descriptions, routes/fares/hours/days, HSTD/NEMT participation, vehicle/facility/equipment maintenance plans, demand-response/intercity service, drug and alcohol policy, safety-sensitive employee list, community/population information, training, prior grant status, budgets, procurement requirements and planning documentation.

Compliance checklist includes coordination evidence, public hearing, private-sector participation, written local complaint process, Title VI documentation, annual civil-rights assurance, Affirmative Action Plan for employers with 50 or more employees, LEP access plan, environmental statement, elderly/persons-with-disabilities hearing or certification, statistical report, disability assurance, ADA equivalent-service certification, charter/school-bus certifications, opinion of counsel, labor letter, authorizing/local-share resolutions, standard/local/regulatory assurances, DBE/WBE policy statement, drug-free workplace certification, lobbying certification, incidental-services certification, federally required/model clauses, and transit-agency safety-plan certification.
The service description documents an 18-county Southeast Kentucky service area and demand-response operation rather than fixed-route service.
The intercity-bus assurance documents 5311(f) activity and describes regional rural-to-urban connections.
provenance_note: Historical application requirements are evidence of why AAP/EEO/Title VI/LEP and personnel/training documentation existed in RTEC's grant-compliance workflow.
